A little about me

Curious by nature.

I’m Zai, an independent web designer based in London. I bring ideas to life through thoughtful strategy, expressive visual systems, and useful digital experiences.

Good design starts with listening.

I like getting close to the people, questions, and details behind a project. From there, I work with clients and collaborators to find a clear idea and turn it into an experience with its own point of view.

My practice moves between research, structure, identity, and interface design. I care about making digital things feel considered and easy to use, while leaving room for personality and surprise.

Open, curious, collaborative.
